blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) told lawmakers on Monday that they lack the authority to screen financial applications, including online lending apps, before they are made available on digital platforms. At a congressional hearing, Bagong Henerasyon Rep. Robert Nazal asked whether the SEC could vet and grant prior approval to financial applications before they are published online. “The SEC has no jurisdiction over them,” said Izza Roselle Sibal, who represented the SEC at a hearing of the House Committee on Banks and Financial Intermediaries.
